usageNotes: Use this to check whether a remote PVE node has pending APT package updates before scheduling maintenance — useful for patch audits across managed remotes. The response reflects the last cached apt cache state on the node; run an apt update on the node first if you need current data. Requires Resource.Modify on the remote/node/system path, so API tokens scoped below that level will be rejected.

examples.summary: List pending APT updates for node pve1 on remote hetzner-de

tips: The Version field is the candidate version; OldVersion is what is currently installed — diff them to gauge update severity.
An empty array means no updates are pending (or the apt cache is stale); trigger an apt-get update on the node if the list looks unexpectedly empty.
Cross-reference Origin field against 'Proxmox' to distinguish PVE-specific packages from upstream Debian packages.
